analyst.summary: Netweb Technologies is riding India's AI-infrastructure buildout with extraordinary growth - revenue nearly tripled year-on-year, led by AI systems - and returns on capital are strong. However, the stock trades at close to 119 times trailing earnings, a valuation that already assumes this pace of growth continues for years, in a business that assembles and integrates computing systems rather than owning unique technology, so we see real valuation risk alongside the genuine operating momentum.
